mustNotFake: Do not fake THS popularity rank.
Do not default hard-risk fields to safe.
Do not call partial public coverage full-market verified unless coverage is actually proven.

nonStFilter.notes: ST/*ST/delisting are filtered by public name text only; announcement risk remains separate.

pctChangeAndPrice.notes: Price < 30 and pctChange 2%-5% are available from spot fields.

thsPopularityTop200.notes: Tushare ths_hot permission is required. Do not fake this field.

peTtmNonLoss.notes: Only dynamic PE is available from spot; this cannot be treated as PE TTM.

hardRiskFlags.notes: Non-standard audit, investigation, major litigation, major reduction and performance blow-up need a real announcement/financial-report source. Do not default to safe.

dailyK.notes: Daily K supports MA, volume, candle, breakout, MACD and KDJ calculations.

weeklyK.notes: Weekly K supports weekly moving-average bullish alignment.

volumeBreakoutInputs.notes: Daily high/low/open/close/volume can support previous-high, platform and red-candle checks.

macdInputs.notes: MACD can be computed from close series.

kdjInputs.notes: KDJ can be computed from high/low/close series.
